facets.description: Salesforce getClient (lines 75-99) refreshes the token on every instantiation, without checking expiry. This adds a network call and DB write each time, and any failure becomes a hard failure where jsforce previously refreshed lazily.
The jsforce.Connection is built with the stale stored credentialKey.access_token instead of the token that was just refreshed.
salesforceTokenSchema requires `scope`, but the Salesforce refresh_token response may not include it, so validation fails.
The refresh response is checked with `response.statusText !== "OK"` instead of `response.ok`.
